Floating lag time was found to increase at higher level of okra gum and decreases as the level of HPMC K4M increases. This is due to high swelling property of the later. Hence, a higher proportion of HPMC K4M is important in the formulation to decrease the flag time. This is also evident from the results of swelling index determination (221.95 to 257.15 (%) for F1 to F7 at the end of 6 h). Swelling index increases with increase in concentration of HPMC K4M signifying its importance for decrease in flag time [27].
